adversary_objection: The only supplied evidence is the MISEV2023 guidance; it does not include any program-specific CMC, analytical validation, batch, stability, formulation-compatibility, or non-rodent biodistribution data required to justify advancing SGL-001 lots/formulations for cross‑species intact‑EV PK/PD bridging. Therefore the proposed Stage‑1 advancement is not supported by the available evidence set.
next_action: Identify and cite supporting canonical evidence, or request evidence acquisition; withdraw unsupported conclusions and revisit this matter before proposing a state change.

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) recommends transparent, orthogonal characterization, defined source-cell controls (e.g., MCB/WCB), validated intact-EV assays, and mechanism-linked potency/stability assays as best-practice prerequisites for advancing EV formulations for cross-species bridging. The allowed evidence set for this review contains only that guideline and does not include program-specific CMC/analytics deliverables; therefore, confirmation that SGL-001 has met those program-specific requirements is not available in the supplied evidence (see evidence_gap).
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific CMC/analytics deliverables (MCB/WCB records, assay validation reports with LLOQ/specificity/precision, GMP-like batch release and stability data, intact-EV recovery in formulation/device compatibility studies, and large-animal intact-EV biodistribution with orthogonal controls) are missing from the supplied evidence.
limitations: Only a single expert-consensus guideline is present in the evidence set; it recommends practices but does not contain SGL-001-specific CMC data.
No assay validation reports, batch records, stability datasets, or MCB/WCB documentation are included in the allowed evidence for this review.
requested_evidence: Validated intact-EV assay reports (fit-for-purpose validation: LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy)
Orthogonal QC panel definitions and method SOPs
Three GMP-like scale-up batch records with release and stability data
Stability-indicating potency assay development and correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint
Formulation/device compatibility studies demonstrating intact-EV recovery
Large-animal (non-rodent) intranasal biodistribution with controls attributing signal to intact EV

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 supports that robust production controls and orthogonal analytics are necessary to de-risk identity and reproducibility. The allowed evidence for this review does not include manufacturing execution records for SGL-001; therefore, claims that SGL-001 materials do or do not demonstrate characterized MCB/WCB or scalable, reproducible production cannot be confirmed from the supplied evidence alone (see evidence_gap).
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing manufacturing execution records: MCB/WCB establishment, process scale-up data, in-process controls, release specifications, and reproducibility analyses across batches.
limitations: No program manufacturing records or scale-up run data are present in the allowed evidence.
MISEV provides framework recommendations but is not direct evidence of implementation for a specific program.
requested_evidence: MCB/WCB establishment reports and characterization data
Process scale-up run records and comparability assessment
In-process control and release specification documents
Analytical comparability reports across multiple batches

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) provides consensus support for requiring an orthogonal QC and validated intact-EV analytic package before high-confidence cross-species intact-EV PK/PD bridging. The allowed evidence set for this review contains only that guideline and does not include SGL-001-specific empirical validation or in vivo bridging data; therefore, whether SGL-001 has executed or met those controls/assays cannot be determined from the supplied evidence (see evidence_gap).
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Absence of program-specific analytics validation, intact-EV-specific in vivo controls, and non-rodent biodistribution/toxicity studies in the supplied evidence.
limitations: Consensus guideline summarizes field-wide challenges and recommendations but does not supply program-level validation or in vivo bridging data.
Several related claims reference primary studies not included in the allowed evidence for this review.
requested_evidence: Rodent and large-animal biodistribution studies with orthogonal intact-EV controls
Assay validation packages for intact-EV detection and potency
Comparability data showing reproducible identity/potency across batches

selected_matter.next_action: Identify and cite supporting canonical evidence, or request evidence acquisition; withdraw unsupported conclusions and revisit this matter before proposing a state change.
selected_matter.question: What evidence-linked identity and potency framework is needed before comparing SGL-001 lots or formulations?
selected_matter.title: Potency and identity characterization
selected_matter.why_it_matters: Without reproducible identity and potency measures, observed biological differences may reflect uncontrolled product variability.

what_changed: The proposed state change was not sufficiently evidence-supported. No scientific, program, or decision state was changed.
why_selected: Selected quality_blocking matter with high advancement value. Deterministic ranking favors program-invalidating issues, then real-world stage blockers, product definition, deployment, quality, contradictions, experiment design, and refinement.
